summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Rekapin new features (TTD/PIC email/training date fields, auto-rules, timeline, per-candidate history, xlsx upload, manual/cron reminder). 13/13 pytest backend tests passed; UI end-to-end covered login, 6 tabs, new fields, Riwayat action, reminder button (200 queued:true), timeline feed (31 entries), delete flow, and confirmed Timeline tab hides the search/filter row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~760 lines; consider splitting into routers/services (auth, candidates, history, cron/email) as it grows past 700 lines.
_apply_auto_rules only fires when payload contains status_training/status_tanda_tangan; leaving them absent skips the rule (currently correct behavior, but worth documenting).
cron endpoint uses hmac.compare_digest which is good; consider structured logging of cron invocations for observability.
seed_data_creation: Created & auto-cleaned TEST_QA candidates (NewFields, AutoTrain, Mundur, HistoryTarget, Excel1, Excel2, Bulk A/B) via pytest teardown; UI test created and deleted TEST_UI QA row.

Reuse for future regressions.
